payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures and approaches used to evaluate the quality of a Q&A platform, particularly Zhihu Live.

claims.text: A data-driven approach is used to evaluate the quality of the Zhihu Live platform, which includes data collection, cleaning, normalization, descriptive analysis, and predictive analysis.
Zhihu Live employs a reward mechanism, such as up-votes and following growth, to encourage high-quality content generation.
The dataset ZhihuLive-DB, containing records and comments, is utilized for quality evaluation and analysis of the platform.
